name: Shelves and Sorcery: Too Many Weapons!
summary: High above the clouds, The Ironkeep Armory houses a legendary collection of weapons gathered from across the realm. Help an eccentric lord restore order to an overwhelming arsenal of swords, axes, daggers, and more. Every weapon has its place. Can you find them all?
